item.description: For more than six decades, local scientists have collected sugar maple leaves from Gatineau Park to measure their radiocarbon levels, creating the longest continuous record of its kind. item.title: Krakow shooting suspect dies as Poland mourns six victims
item.description: Kraków's historic main square in southern Poland reopened to the public on Sunday 8 November, just over 24 hours after a deadly shooting left six people dead and 15 others injured. Residents are lighting candles in memory of the victims, while bullet marks remain visible on café windows. Publicado también por: The Hindu - International, Africanews, Euronews. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
item.description: Jensen Huang, CEO of US tech giant Nvidia, is being investigated by the company's board after reports that Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.” Huang admitted to having an intimate relationship with a business executive who is alleged to have been spying on behalf of China. Publicado también por: BBC News - Business, Euronews. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: France accuses Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps of cyberattack on supermarket fridges
item.description: French officials suspect Iranian hackers disrupted refrigeration systems at hundreds of businesses in October, amid wider cyberattacks linked to war. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Russia's leading independent newspaper closes after eviction
item.description: The outlet has been evicted from its offices of three decades and says it's been blocked from receiving donations. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Queensland security guard who fought for Russia missing, feared dead

item.title: Misa multitudinaria de León XIV en Buenos Aires: «La familia cristiana no está superada, es un pilar entre las precariedades»
item.description: El Papa ha proclamado en Buenos Aires que «la familia cristiana no está superada», pues es un «pilar entre las precariedades de nuestra época». Ha sido durante la misa más multitudinaria de lo que lleva de Pontificado, ante aproximadamente dos millones y medio de personas, entre ellas Javier Milei y su hermana Karina , secretaria general de la presidencia. La capital de Argentina ha salido a las calles con un entusiasmo inusitado que ha desbordado todas las previsiones. Al menos otro medio millón de personas ha salido de sus casas para ver pasar el coche, aunque el papamóvil descubierto sólo… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Iran was behind cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers, Paris says
item.description: French foreign minister vows European sanctions against Tehran over ‘unprecedented’ hacks last month France has said Iran was responsible for a massive cyber-attack on supermarket freezers and chiller cabinets that was described by its foreign minister as being an act of “unprecedented scale and unprecedented aggression”. Jean-Noël Barrot said “Europe-wide sanctions” would be imposed against those responsible, adding that the attacks – which took control of digital thermostats to push temperatures up to above 50C – constituted “a major violation of the nation’s interests”. item.title: Meghan Markle pulls out of Brussels speech after dad’s arrest over child sex abuse images
item.description: Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, has pulled out of making a joint speech with the Duke of Sussex in Brussels about online child safety because she is “not strong enough” after her father’s arrest. Prince Harry and Meghan had both been due to deliver the keynote address to the European Parliament on Tuesday.
